title: Are Compressed Language Models Less Subgroup Robust?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group accuracy (WGA) on subgroups defined by the presence of sensitive demographic identity terms (e.g., male, female, LGBTQ, Christian, Muslim, Black, White) using the CivilComments dataset.
Measuring worst-group accuracy (WGA) on subgroups defined by the ideological direction of Supreme Court decisions (liberal vs. conservative) using the SCOTUS dataset.

Assessing worst-group accuracy (WGA) on subgroups defined by the presence or absence of spurious linguistic features (negation words like 'nobody', 'no', 'never', 'nothing') using the MultiNLI dataset.
